description.value: Pizza Pizza is a Canadian fast-food pizza chain founded in 1967, now operating over 750 locations from BC to Newfoundland. This Penticton location on Main Street serves hot pizza by the slice, panzerottis, poutine, wings, and more, with dine-in, takeout, and delivery all available. It is a practical fueling stop for cyclists, with late-night service and a broad menu that includes gluten-free, vegan, and dairy-free options.
